Launcher report contains string identities, not passed/name objects; final3 uses strict exact identity-set validation after real re-execution.

verificationLimits: 304 scopes have source/contract review and associated regressions; this is not 304 independent exact dynamic fault reproductions.
Windows local and fixed Linux container probes only; native Linux/macOS, Firefox, remote CI and full release smoke were not run.
Browser matrix was not rerun; prior R2 WebKit questions runtime failure remains FAILED and assigned to R6.
Trusted Java SPI contracts are not an OS sandbox. Unsupported patch deletion/executable modes/no-final-newline remain explicit rejections.
Local receipts bind exit codes, logs, outputs and inputs; they are not a remote trusted attestation.
